description: This file defines the LoadShedQueueFlowController class, which implements load shedding flow control logic based on CPU usage and cluster load conditions within the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: LoadShedQueueFlowController
classes.description: Implements queue flow control based on load shedding options and environment statistics, providing methods to create instances triggered by CPU or load thresholds.

methods.name: CreateAsPercentOfLoadSheddingLimit
methods.description: Creates a flow controller triggered when the load shedding percentage reaches a specified limit.

methods.name: CreateAsPercentageOfCPU
methods.description: Creates a flow controller triggered when CPU usage reaches a specified percentage.

methods.name: GetMaxAddCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of items that can be added to the queue based on current load conditions.
